question: Which public EGFR structural features support a compact VHH design exercise?
observations: RCSB PDB identifies 4KRL as an X-ray structure of nanobody/VHH 7D12 in complex with domain III of the human EGFR extracellular region.
The record reports 2.85 angstrom resolution and a heterodimeric biological assembly containing one VHH chain and one EGFR chain.
The retained source is an existing experimental complex; this case contains no new VHH sequence, design calculation, docking result, or candidate ranking.
interpretation: PDB 4KRL supports a source-grounded lesson on an observed EGFR–VHH binding pose and the distinction between experimental structural evidence and future design work.
limitations: The case does not recompute contacts or validate residue-level interface claims.
The public structure alone does not establish the performance of any new VHH candidate.
Rosalind launcher readiness is documented separately and does not establish a scientific run.
